parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of a ceiling fan, typically made of wood or lightweight composite material. It consists of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air, providing cooling and ventilation in a room.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting structure of the ceiling fan, made of steel for strength and durability. It connects the fan to the ceiling and houses the motor.
parts.Functional_description: The base body supports the fan assembly, holds the motor, and ensures stable operation when the fan is running.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary and does not move during operation.
